description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Matanuska Valley Federal Credit Union is hiring an Enterprise Integration Developer to design, build, and maintain integrations, automations, and software solutions. The role connects enterprise systems, improves business processes and member experience, and supports delivery, documentation, and continuous improvement across the organization.
Enterprise Integration Developer designing, building, and supporting ESB-based integrations, APIs, and automation across enterprise systems

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and support enterprise software solutions, APIs, integrations, and automation that align with organizational objectives and enterprise architecture standards
• Develop and maintain secure, scalable, and reusable integrations utilizing the Enterprise Service Bus (ESB), vendor SDKs, APIs, web services, middleware, and automation platforms
• Analyze business requirements and processes to design technical solutions that improve operational efficiency, data quality, system integration, employee productivity, member experience, and regulatory compliance
• Create and maintain reusable integration patterns, services, data exchange processes, and technical components that promote enterprise standards and long-term maintainability
• Participate in software deployments, system upgrades, migrations, vendor implementations, testing, and post-production validation to ensure reliable solution delivery
• Partner with business units and project teams to gather requirements, participate in discovery and solution design sessions, provide technical consultation, and support enterprise initiatives
• Participate in Agile Scrum ceremonies, estimate development effort, manage assigned backlog work, and deliver solutions that meet sprint commitments and project timelines
• Maintain technical documentation, including application designs, APIs, integration diagrams, support procedures, and source code repositories in accordance with established development standards
• Follow enterprise security, data governance, architecture, and change management standards while ensuring solutions meet organizational compliance requirements
• Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and provide ongoing support and continuous improvement for enterprise applications and integrations
• Research emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions that enhance enterprise platforms, automation capabilities, and overall business performance

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, or related discipline; or
equivalent experience
• 0-2 years of experience in systems integration or application development
• REST APIs, JSON/XML, SQL, GitHub, JavaScript, C#, Python, or
similar modern development languages
• Basic understanding of API authentication
methods and integration concepts
• 3-5 years of experience in systems integration or application development
• Proven technical skills of a Developer I role, plus API design and development,
Enterprise integrations. PortX Integration Manager or similar, GitHUb source control
management, SQL Server and relational databases, Vendor SDK utilization, CI/CD
concepts, Agile Scrum methodologies
• 6+ years of experience
• Proven technical skills of a Developer II, plus
Enterprise integration architecture, PortX Integration Manager administration and
design, Complex API ecosystem design, Event-driven architectures, Cloud integration
technologies, DevOps and CI/CD practices, Solution architecture and systems design,
Vendor platform integration strategy
• High integrity and professionalism
• Always maintains
confidentiality
• Highly self-motivated, organized, and able to work independently
• Demonstrates strong ownership, initiative, and commitment to continuous improvement
• Ability to follow direction while exercising leadership within assigned enterprise systems
